boundary: These are local legal-support review definitions, not live ABL schedules or notifications.

automations.name: Legal support regression check
automations.cadence: After every prompt, skill, policy, mapping or source-contract change
automations.purpose: Run both prompt versions through the same six matter, access and general-IT cases before activation.
stop_on: Any expected state or required control fails
A reference-data or information-barrier block can be overridden
An unmapped or restricted case reaches the provider
A duplicate matter or unauthorised action occurs

automations.name: Weekly legal support outcome review
automations.purpose: Review accepted proposals, corrections, access and matter exceptions, provider usage, review effort and total cost.
automations.minimum_evidence: Representative reviewed service-desk outcomes; six synthetic cases alone are insufficient to scale.

automations.name: Monthly relevance and cost review
automations.cadence: Monthly and after a material policy, platform or knowledge change
automations.purpose: Decide keep, change, replace with a rule or knowledge article, roll back, retire or stop.
checks: Business need and named owner still exist
Authoritative sources and controls remain current
Quality and handling evidence remain above threshold
Review, rework and model cost remain proportionate
No simpler deterministic alternative is better

automations.name: Harvey work-product regression
automations.cadence: After every material prompt, skill, workflow, model or knowledge-source change
automations.purpose: Rerun approved synthetic matter packs for issue coverage, source integrity, permissions and lawyer reviewability before release.
stop_on: A material proposition lacks a verifiable source
A permission or information-barrier test fails
The workflow presents work as final legal advice
A critical expected issue is omitted

automations.name: Weekly Harvey adoption and quality review
automations.purpose: Review accepted work products, corrections, review effort, incidents, adoption by role and support demand.

automations.name: Monthly Harvey relevance and cost review
automations.cadence: Monthly and after a material practice, policy or platform change
automations.purpose: Decide keep, change, scale, replace, retire or stop using quality, realised capacity, total cost and safer-alternative evidence.
checks: Matter-level need and accountable owner still exist
Sources, permissions and review controls remain current
Adoption produces accepted work rather than unused output
Licence, integration, support, training and review cost remain proportionate
Fixed-fee margin, write-down or capacity claims reconcile to finance data
